name: Gain activated abilities — legendary, opponents', graveyard and loyalty variants
notes: Sweep theme 6 (2026-10-06). "Has all activated abilities of …" only parsed the 'on the battlefield', '+1/+1 counter' and exile forms. Robaran Mercenaries takes abilities only from legendary creatures you control (Arcanis, not Prodigal Pyromancer). Sharkey takes them from lands opponents control except mana abilities (Mishra's Factory's animate and pump, not its {T}: Add {C}; nothing from your own Maze of Ith). Thranduil takes them from Elf cards in your graveyard only (Llanowar Elves in yours, not Elvish Mystic in the opponent's, not Prodigal Pyromancer's ping from a non-Elf). Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God takes only loyalty abilities of other planeswalkers.
